description: This file contains API-related utility functions for a React-based web application, including environment URL normalization, and functions for user authentication such as login and signup.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL string.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures that the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1' if it doesn't already.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Determines if the current hostname indicates a Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the full protocol and hostname of the current window, used for Kavia preview URLs.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL string appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable URLs, handling absolute, relative, and proxy URLs appropriately.

methods.name: resolveBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Computes the base API URL based on environment variables and current host conditions.
